patch_description: This edit replaces the fully independent pre/post phase stack with a more structured, symmetry-regularized ansatz. The new block keeps local flexibility via unique RY rotations on all 8 qubits, but cuts parameter count per block in half by sharing phase parameters across even/odd qubits. It also strengthens information flow with a two-stage entangler: a nearest-neighbor CZ ring followed by long-range CNOT bridges. This is a better match for the fixed ZZ feature map and mean-Z readout, because it encourages global mixing while reducing overfitting and improving parameter efficiency.
